The tumor are mainly located in the submucosa with extension to the mucosa, muscularis propria and perijejunal fat tissue. The mucosa shows marked hemorrhagic necrosis and ulceration. No obvious squamous differentiation or glandular formation is found. The morphologic and immunohistochemical results are similar to those in the previous biopsy specimen (WFH 02-6747). According to the clinical history, no obvious thyroid lesion is found.
